name: tabular_imbalance_pipeline
title: 1:400 fraud detection with SMOTE inside an imblearn Pipeline, a three-way split and the threshold tuned on the validation half
origin: hardening round 2, tester domain-tabular: the correct half of the imbalance pair

forbidden.why: the only fit call in this project is model.fit at line 88, on train_x; every transformer and the resampler are Pipeline steps and are refit by whoever holds the pipeline
pipeline.py declares the imputer, scaler, encoder and SMOTENC as steps and calls fit on none of them
valid_x reaches predict_proba at line 62 and test_x reaches predict_proba at line 70; nothing is fitted on either

cross_val_score at line 56 is handed build_estimator(), an imblearn Pipeline whose first step is the ColumnTransformer - which is the fix MLV103 asks for; the resampler is a step too, so each fold resamples only its own training half
no CV call exists in pipeline.py
hour_of_day is an integer hour-of-day feature, not a timestamp: nothing parses a date, converts one or sorts by one, so there is no temporal signal to split wrongly
f1_score at line 75 is fed `decisions`, produced by the threshold comparison at line 72; roc_auc_score and average_precision_score are score metrics fed a predict_proba column
roc_auc_score is fed model.predict_proba(test_x)[:, 1] at line 70, a score column rather than a hard label
seed_everything() seeds random and numpy at lines 33-34, both splits and the StratifiedKFold carry random_state=SEED, and SMOTENC and the classifier carry random_state=SEED
both train_test_split calls (lines 47 and 49) and StratifiedKFold at line 55 pass random_state=SEED
there is no torch in this project and no hand-written gradient step
model.eval() is a torch idiom with no sklearn equivalent
torch.no_grad() has no meaning in a scikit-learn program
no device is ever named in this project

notes: This project is the direct false-positive trap for MLV104 (resampling before the split), which is catalogued but not implemented. If MLV104 is ever built, the SMOTENC declared at pipeline.py:47 must stay silent: it is a Pipeline step, so imblearn calls fit_resample on each fold's training half and leaves the validation half untouched. A rule that keys on 'a resampler exists' rather than on where it is fitted fires here.
MLV117 (train_test_split without stratify=) is catalogued but not implemented; for the record, both splits pass stratify=
